description: Classify any address on 7 EVM chains before interacting with it: EOA, EIP-7702-delegated EOA or contract, code size, nonce, native balance, and proxy detection (EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots, legacy ZeppelinOS proxies such as USDC, and EIP-1167 minimal proxies). You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.003 USDC on Base)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche. Chain IDs also accepted.

name: chain_address_info
